args.body: If director-cad60-labor-headroom.json commits before CATALOGUE-CAD60-HANDLING-TIME closes, use it in the existing rehearsal readback. Compare observed operator handling time with the labor-only headroom and keep unmeasured acquisition, revisions and administration explicit. If the rehearsal already closed, reuse its evidence. Preserve the exact Stream Commerce draft and existing send decision workflow. A real authorized pilot with measured total effort and verified costs would support a stronger price decision.

description: The catalogue verifier caught the fictional barcode swap, and a separate SKU comparison located the two affected rows. The next commercial question is how much operator time CAD 60 can cover. Run a price sensitivity check alongside the delegated handling-time rehearsal. The feedback view has five unclassified sources and no new interpreted feedback, so demand remains unknown. The Stream Commerce draft still depends on its recorded operator send decision, and paid fulfillment depends on administrative acceptance and confirmed collection. Those conditions do not block the offline work. Treasury shows zero verified available funds and no verified revenue. Public deployment remains subject to host-enforced independent review.
